# Ramesh Das — Agentic AI Engineer & Backend Architect

> Ramesh Das (Ramesh Kumar Das, handle: mrdasdeveloper) is a senior Agentic AI Engineer and
> Backend Architect based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He has 6+ years of production software experience
> building AI-first platforms, LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, multi-agent systems, and
> FastAPI/Django microservices. He also ships full-stack products with Next.js and React.
> He currently leads AI development at KLIKY AI on WinstaAI — a live agentic AI SaaS with
> generative features, agent workflows, and multi-model LLM routing. Open to remote work
> worldwide: full-time, contract, freelance, retainer, or staff augmentation.

### Areas of Expertise

- Agentic AI systems — LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen; multi-agent handoffs, tool-calling, planners
- RAG pipelines — vector search, hybrid retrieval, chunking, reranking, citations, eval loops
- LLM orchestration — OpenAI (GPT-4o), Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, open-weight models (Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek)
- FastAPI microservices — async Python, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, event-driven design
- Full-stack development — Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, SSR/SSG, i18n
- SaaS architecture — multi-tenancy, Stripe/PayPal billing, credit systems, admin dashboards, metering
- Business automation — scheduled jobs, queues, webhooks, API/CRM integration, dead-letter queues, retries
- DevOps and cloud — Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, GitHub Actions, AWS, GCP, Azure, Terraform, NGINX
- Generative media — text-to-image (ComfyUI, Replicate), STT/TTS, OCR, face swap, video/audio AI, GPU inference
- LLM fine-tuning — LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, instruction tuning, domain adaptation
- LLMOps / MLOps — RAGAS, TruLens, prompt evals, drift detection, model versioning, A/B testing
- AI safety and guardrails — allow-lists, schema validation, rate limiting, human-in-the-loop approvals, trace logging
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool-calling patterns
- Vector databases — Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, ChromaDB, pgvector

### Architecture Experience

  and billing. Stack: FastAPI, LangChain, ComfyUI, RAG, Docker, Kubernetes.

  transcription, multilingual dubbing, DeepL. Stack: Django, Speech AI, DeepL, Firebase, JWT.

- **Paperport** (AJATH Info Tech, 2021–2023): AI content generator — structured presentations and
  roadmaps from unstructured text and images; Firebase auth, OTP, push notifications.
  Stack: Python, OpenAI, Firebase, React, REST API.

- **PathHub** (Saraj System, 2019–2021): Medical diagnostic platform — HIPAA-focused reporting,
  real-time imaging, secure access, scalable reporting for a hospital network.
  Stack: Django, PostgreSQL, REST API, Docker.
